name: saved_default
yaml:
version: 1
device:
  serial: ''
  prefer_usb: true
  auto_connect: true
  server_port: 1234
  known: []
  macs: {}
placement:
  monitor: ''
  edge: right
  span_start: 0
  span_end: 1600
  offset: 0.5
  align: proportional
  corner_priority: right
layouts:
  devices: {}
motion:
  gain: 1.0
  report_hz: 1000
  hid_clamp: 127
  entry_margin_px: 2
  exit_overflow_px: 80
  debounce_ms: 250
  arm_px: 10
  arm_window_ms: 80
  edge_band_px: 1
  boundary_inset_px: 0
keyboard:
  forward: true
  suppress_pc: true
  layout: us
  passthrough_keys:
  - VK_LWIN
  - VK_RWIN
hotkeys:
  toggle: Ctrl+Alt+S
  panic: Ctrl+Alt+Q
ui:
  language: zh_CN
  theme: dark
  tray_notifications: true
  close_to_tray: false
misc:
  clipboard_sync: true
  keep_screen_on: true
  restore_pointer_speed: -3
  forward_audio: false
